sections.heading: Acceptance of Terms

sections.heading: Description of Service
sections.content: LoveLog is a personal dating and flirt tracking application that allows you to organize information about people you are dating or interested in, track dates, record evaluations, and maintain satisfaction scores. The App is designed for personal, non-commercial use.

By entering such data, you confirm that you have obtained any necessary consent or have a legitimate basis to store this information. You are solely responsible for compliance with applicable data protection laws regarding third-party data.
